hook.name: CurbHook (drill)
hook.description: Curb: a LULD-style circuit breaker. Refuses a swap that would end outside a band around a time-weighted reference and further from it (a swap toward the reference always passes); a price that holds at the band's edge halts the pool in both directions for at most a fixed time, then it reopens on its own. No fees, no deltas, no liquidity callbacks, not upgradeable. This deployment is the drill pool with short timings.
